description: List applications with optional status and company filters, an optional text query and an optional deadline range. Inputs: optional status to filter by stage, an optional company substring to match (case insensitive), an optional query that searches the role, notes and source text (case insensitive), for example referral or LinkedIn, and optional deadline_after and deadline_before as YYYY-MM-DD. Both dates are included, and applications without a deadline are left out when you pass either one. Returns all matching applications as a structured list with their ids, so you can see application ids without exporting a full report. Example prompt: "Which applications have a deadline in November 2026?"

company.description: Only list applications whose company name contains this text (case insensitive).

deadline_after.description: Only list applications with a deadline on or after this YYYY-MM-DD date.

deadline_before.description: Only list applications with a deadline on or before this YYYY-MM-DD date.

query.description: Only list applications whose role, notes or source contains this text (case insensitive).

status.description: Only list applications in this stage.

name: list_applications

added.description: The day it was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

deadline.description: Last day to apply as YYYY-MM-DD, or null.

interview_date.description: Interview date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or null.

source.description: Where you found the posting, or null.

status.description: The stage the application is in.

updated.description: The day it last changed, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: List applications
